## Wave 5 Summary

This wave executes the two transit-dynamics forward computes from the S99 non-equilibrium-transit litreview (G6), both CONVERGENT across the paired reports. **W5-1 (S100b-BOX-DELTA-BOGOLIUBOV)** is the honest re-open of the FAILed `S85-W7-CUSP-BOGOLIUBOV` transfer-matrix gate under a structurally NEW discretization: the fold treated as its genuine impulsive geometry — a box scattering potential `V(η) = (1/4)ȧ² + (1/2)ä·a` (Sparn Eq. 4) with TWO delta-peaks at the switch-on/off boundaries — for which the transfer-matrix method is EXACT, versus the S85 smooth-interpolated-cusp treatment for which it is invalid (artificial interior reflections, OOM N_seg-sensitivity). The extracted `|β_pivot|²` is tested for N_seg-stability and against the Schmidt Eq. 75 sub-horizon closed form `sin²[μ_k Δη]`. **W5-2 (S100b-FOLD-RANGE-SCALING)** pins the fold's fast-quench universality class: whether the canonical `P_exc = 1.000` / 59.8-pair Parker saturation is fold-RANGE-controlled (Rao class: `v > v_c`, `ρ ~ δ_max`, rate-independent) or rate-controlled (Li KZ-survival class), via a two-axis scan — transit rate (Mach ∈ [5, 30] at fixed range) and fold range (spectral-excursion rescale at fixed rate).

Carry-forward provenance: W5-1 = transit-litrev V.2 + kitaev-litrev V.1 (merged; context item 12); W5-2 = transit-litrev V.4 + kitaev-litrev V.3 (merged; context item 13).

## §W5-1. S100b-BOX-DELTA-BOGOLIUBOV

### Honest re-open declaration (MANDATORY context — laws (a)–(d))

**(a) Original FAIL cited explicitly.** This gate re-opens the corridor closed by:

```
S85-W7-CUSP-BOGOLIUBOV: FAIL -- value=-2.019676 scheme=transfer-matrix convention=BD-in-out L_max=10
sha256=b17807eb5930d0bb80142b4b45ae579cdb9465ac7181e4b6f9f8e45f46bd579c
(computations/session-85/s85_gate_verdicts.txt; producing script computations/session-85/s85_w7_cusp_bogoliubov.py)
```

The S85 gate fitted the Bogoliubov UV exponent on a transfer-matrix extraction and returned −2.019676 against the pre-registered Airy band [−0.7167, −0.6167] — a 3× over-steep slope.

**(b) Structural reason the recipe differs.** The S85 machinery modeled the fold as a SMOOTH interpolated cusp — `z″/z(t) = A·|t − t_c|^α` with α = 1 (square-root van Hove form, Airy class) — and applied piecewise-constant transfer-matrix segmentation to that smooth profile. That is precisely the regime where the transfer-matrix method is INVALID: every interior segment boundary of a smooth profile generates a spurious partial reflection; the accumulated artificial reflections make `|β_k|²` N_seg-sensitive at OOM level and steepen the fitted UV tail (the −2.0197 vs −2/3 signature). This failure mode is this agent's standing debugging note AND is independently established by the S99 sweep: Sparn (paper 03) uses transfer-matrix **successfully but only for genuinely sharp boundaries** (delta-peak discontinuities `ψ_k′ → ψ_k′ + Ω ψ_k`; for linear expansion the potential is a **box of height H₀²/4 with delta-distributions at the abrupt start and end of the ramp**). The fold's genuine geometry is NOT a smooth cusp: the transit is impulsive (`dt_transit = 1.1302e-3 M_KK⁻¹`, `H·dt = 0.663 < 1`, Mach 13.75 supersonic) — i.e., exactly the box+delta sudden limit where the transfer matrix is EXACT (finitely many genuine sharp interfaces, no interior segmentation of a smooth profile). Both S99 litrev reports are CONVERGENT on this reading (transit report §II.1 + §IV.1; kitaev report §II.1(a) + §IV "the transfer-matrix corridor is reopened — for the sudden limit only").

**(c) NEW gate, NEW pre-registered machinery — no Class-6 adjacency.** This is NOT a re-run of the S85 machinery hoping for PASS (`v3-closure-recovery.md` PROHIBITED_ACTIONS Class 6, iterate-until-PASS). It is a NEW gate-ID with a structurally different discretization class pinned at plan-freeze: `scheme = BOX-DELTA-SUDDEN` (box interior + two boundary deltas; Sparn Eq. 4 construction) versus S85's `SMOOTH-CUSP-AIRY` (interpolated α=1 cusp segmentation), and a different comparison observable (Schmidt Eq. 75 closed-form match + N_seg-stability conjunction, versus S85's Airy `k^{−2/3}` exponent fit). The recipe is independently falsifiable: if `|β_pivot|²` remains OOM-sensitive to N_seg even under sharp-boundary discretization, the gate FAILs and the transfer-matrix corridor closes for BOTH discretization classes.

**(d) The S85 FAIL is NOT vindicated, NOT overturned, NOT superseded.** The Sparn result does not rescue the S85 run — the S85 FAIL stands as the permanent verdict on the smooth-cusp machinery (verdict permanence per `gate-verdicts.md`). No Option-A `supersedes=` token applies (that pathway is for corrective emissions of the SAME gate-ID; this is a different gate testing a different recipe). This block is a RECIPE pre-registration with an open outcome, not a claim it passes. The companion comment row emitted with this gate's verdict line MUST reference the S85 line (full 64-hex `b17807eb5930d0bb80142b4b45ae579cdb9465ac7181e4b6f9f8e45f46bd579c`) as cross-gate audit context, explicitly tagged `predecessor=` (NOT `supersedes=`).

    (2) Extract the Sparn Eq. 2-5 conventions (V(eta) definition; a_k/b_k/c_k
    reflection dictionary; N_k = |b_k|^2/|c_k|^2 with unitarity

    (sub-horizon sin[mu_k Delta_eta] vs super-horizon sinh[Lambda_k Delta_eta];

## §W5-2. S100b-FOLD-RANGE-SCALING

### Scoping notes (MANDATORY context)

**N_pair caveat (carried per the wave law).** `n_pairs = 59.8` is a PROJECTED CHARGE `⟨Q⟩_GGE` — a BCS-projection count with known overestimates (S74 NOETHER-CHAIN framing) — NOT a literal pair count. The regime-robust structural claim is `P_exc = 1` (S38, T4 PROVEN: N_pair = 1 exact reduction at 1.2e-14; pair wavefunction 93% B2 / 6.3% B1). All scaling conclusions in this gate key on `P_exc` and on RELATIVE `n_pairs` scaling `n(λ)/n(1)` — never on the absolute 59.8. Any registry text downstream of this gate citing `n_a^GGE`-class labels carries the parse-tree-expansion discipline (`cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Observable-Naming-History vs Parse-Tree-Structure"`).

**Universality-class landscape (from the CONVERGENT litrev pair).** Rao (paper 08, trapped-ion LZ + Rice-Mele, experimentally confirmed): above a critical quench rate `v_c` (itself scaling with quench range `δ_max`), KZ rate-scaling `ρ ~ v^{1/2}` is REPLACED by rate-independent range-scaling `ρ ~ δ_max`. Li (paper 13, tricritical Ising): KZ scaling SURVIVES adiabatic-impulse breakdown iff `z′ < z + 1/ν` (TCI: z = z′ = 1, ν_μ = 5/4, r_μ = 9/5). Both reports place the fold in Rao's class structurally (saturation is rate-independent by construction); this gate is the pre-registered COMPUTE that tests it, with the Li inequality as a diagnostic-only adjacency (the fold is first-order at τ_fold = 0.19, not a tricritical point — but the van Hove fold is tricritical-ADJACENT, kitaev litrev V.4).

**GGE scope.** The relic occupation this gate concerns is the GGE's FORMATION amplitude at the transit — upstream of, and independent from, the post-transit thermalization question ("GGE never thermalizes" is RETRACTED-S39 / atlas-04 T3 BROKEN; what survives is transit-window validity + fabric-scale CG(24) Poisson integrability). No claim in this block exceeds that register status.

### R3 YAML gate block

# ---- Identity ----

  P_exc varies by < 1% (absolute) across Mach in [5, 30] at fixed fold range, AND
  the relative pair content n_pairs(lambda)/n_pairs(1) increases monotonically
  with the fold range at fixed rate.

method:
  description: >
    (1) Reconstruct the canonical S38 sudden-quench excitation model (the
    P_exc_kz = 1.0 producer): per-mode Landau-Zener/Bogoliubov crossing of the
    BCS-class gap at the fold with the S38 canonical exponents nu = 0.5 (BCS
    mean-field), z = 2.0 (BCS dynamical), kz_exp = nu/(1+z nu) = 0.25; LZ diabatic
    (excitation) probability per crossing P_exc = exp(-pi Delta_min^2 / (2 v_eff))
    with the S38 adiabaticity ratio adiab = tau_Q/tau_0 << 1 (sudden). Reference
    machinery: computations/session-38/s38_kz_defects.py; reference output pinned
    as s38_kz_defects.npz. Pre-flight CHK-S38: at the canonical point
    (Mach = 13.75, lambda = 1) the reconstruction must reproduce P_exc = 1.0
    within 1e-6 ABSOLUTE against P_exc_kz (canonical_constants) — HARD-ABORT on
    failure (reconstruction bug, not physics).
    (2) Extract Rao's v_c / delta_max scaling template (the rho ~ delta_max
    rate-independent law above v_c, and the v_c(delta_max) boundary) from the
    pinned Rao PDF, and the Li inequality z' < z + 1/nu from the pinned Li PDF,
    at runtime — fetched sources only, never training knowledge; log the
    extracted forms in stdout.
    (3) RATE SCAN (axis i): vary the transit rate via Mach in [5, 30] (11 linear
    points, 13.75 included exactly) at FIXED fold range; rate map pinned as
    v_eff proportional to Mach at fixed fold geometry, i.e.
    dt_transit(Mach) = dt_transit * 13.75/Mach. Compute P_exc(Mach) per mode and
    the aggregate relative n_pairs(Mach)/n_pairs(13.75). Statistic:
    Delta_P_exc = max - min of P_exc over the scan (ABSOLUTE, on [0,1]).
    (4) RANGE SCAN (axis ii): vary the fold range delta_max via amplitude rescale
    lambda * (spectral excursion) with lambda in [0.25, 4] (9 log points, 1.0
    included exactly) at FIXED Mach = 13.75; the excursion profile from
    s64_epsilon_profile.npz channels S_dense/dS_dense/d2S_dense, anchored to the
    canonical dS_fold = 58672.80241318 and d2S_fold = 317862.84898132
    (canonical_constants; the lambda rescale acts on the excursion amplitude,
    holding the profile SHAPE and the transit rate fixed). Compute
    n_rel(lambda) = n_pairs(lambda)/n_pairs(1). Statistic: Spearman rho_S of
    n_rel vs lambda over the 9-point grid; diagnostic power-law fit exponent
    p_range from log n_rel vs log lambda (the Rao rho ~ delta_max analog expects
    p_range ~ 1, reported as diagnostic, NOT gated).
    (5) Li-adjacency DIAGNOSTIC (not a gate criterion): extract effective
    (z, z', nu) from the fold's gap-closure profile Delta(tau) ~ |tau -
    tau_fold|^{nu z} near tau_fold = 0.19 (s64 dense channels) and evaluate the
    Li inequality z' < z + 1/nu; report which side it lands. Feeds the
    tricritical-adjacency follow-up (kitaev litrev V.4) — informational only.
    (6) Carry the N_pair caveat into every output: absolute 59.8 never gates;
    P_exc and RELATIVE n_pairs only.
  producing_script: "computations/session-100b/s100b_fold_range_scaling.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "conjunction: absolute-spread inequality AND rank-correlation inequality"
  form: >
    PASS iff [ Delta_P_exc = max-min P_exc over Mach in [5,30] < 0.01 ABSOLUTE ]
    AND [ Spearman rho_S( n_rel(lambda), lambda ) > 0.99 over lambda in [0.25,4] ]

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "Delta_P_exc = 0.01 (ABSOLUTE on P_exc in [0,1]) ; rho_S = 0.99"

  range_map_pin: "delta_max == lambda * (fold spectral excursion); excursion profile channels S_dense/dS_dense/d2S_dense from s64_epsilon_profile.npz; canonical anchors dS_fold = 58672.80241318, d2S_fold = 317862.84898132 (canonical_constants); lambda rescales amplitude at fixed shape and fixed rate"

# (7) substitution_chain — the [SIGN] rate-vs-range direction claim
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "Saturation (P_exc = 1.000 at the canonical Mach) implies P_exc is
            rate-INDEPENDENT across Mach in [5,30]; the relic occupation is then
            carried by the fold RANGE (mode count within the spectral excursion
            window), i.e. n_pairs increases with delta_max — the Rao v > v_c
            class. Conversely, measured rate-dependence >= 1% implies the fold is
            NOT deeply saturated and the rate-controlled KZ class revives."

    Definition 1: P_exc(v_eff) = exp(-pi Delta_min^2 / (2 v_eff)) — LZ diabatic
                  (excitation) probability per fold crossing [LZ closed form; S38
                  canonical machinery s38_kz_defects.py: adiab = tau_Q/tau_0 << 1
                  => sudden quench => P_exc = 1].
    Definition 2: v_eff proportional to Mach at fixed fold geometry [rate_map_pin;
                  canonical Mach_max_framework = 13.75; dt_transit = 1.1302e-3
                  M_KK^{-1}, H*dt = 0.663 < 1].
    Definition 3: P_exc_kz = 1.0 EXACT at the canonical point [S38;
                  canonical_constants P_exc_kz].
    Substitute:   define eps := pi Delta_min^2 / (2 v_eff(13.75)), so
                  P_exc(13.75) = e^{-eps} and
                  P_exc(Mach) = e^{-eps * 13.75/Mach}.
    Simplify:     Delta_P_exc[5->30] = e^{-eps*13.75/30} - e^{-eps*13.75/5}
                                     = e^{-0.4583 eps} - e^{-2.75 eps}

                  under the S38 canonical P_exc = 1.0.
    Direction:    eps -> 0  =>  Delta_P_exc -> 0: rate-INDEPENDENCE across the
                  scan holds iff the canonical saturation has exponent margin
                  eps < 4.36e-3 (P_exc(13.75) > 0.99564). A measured
                  Delta_P_exc >= 0.01 forces eps >= 4.36e-3 — the fold would NOT
                  be deeply saturated, reviving rate (KZ) control and

                  mode is excited with probability ~1, so the aggregate
                  occupation reduces to the COUNT of modes inside the excursion
                  window: n_pairs(lambda * DeltaS) is monotonically increasing in
                  lambda — the substrate analog of Rao's rho ~ delta_max.
    Conclusion:   PASS direction = (Delta_P_exc < 0.01 AND rho_S > 0.99)
                  <=> Rao v > v_c range-controlled class;
                  FAIL direction = Delta_P_exc >= 0.01 <=> rate-controlled
                  (slow-quench KZ) class, contradicting the canonical saturation.

    (Delta_P_exc lands below threshold — rate-flat as predicted) AND
    (d n_rel / d lambda > 0 across the grid — range-increasing as predicted).
